activity.notes: Abdelkader was formally invested by tribal allegiance as leader on 27 November 1832 and built an autonomous Algerian state resisting French conquest. His political-military sovereignty ended with his surrender to French forces on 23 December 1847. ATLAS therefore models his primary polity as the Emirate of Abdelkader, not the French colonial administration and not a retrojected modern Republic of Algeria.
